Your SENTRA workspace

Profile, notifications and a clear view of how monitoring works.

Profile

Email identifies your company-issued account. Contact your company to change it.

Changes dashboard timestamps and reports. The recording’s video offset and Python rule clock stay unchanged.

Account security

Changing your password ends all active login sessions. Forgotten password? Contact your company for a reset.

Desktop & Android notifications

Checking notification support…

  1. Open SENTRA in Chrome/Edge and press Enable notifications, then Allow.
  2. On Android, use Install app / Add to Home screen. A deployed HTTPS address is needed; your computer’s localhost is not accessible from your phone.
  3. Keep browser notifications and lock-screen notifications enabled in Android settings.
  4. Background push requires the company’s push worker online. The dashboard tab can be closed; Python must still run to generate new detections.
  5. If blocked, use the browser’s site settings to allow notifications, then enable again.
  6. A generic APK/WebView wrapper needs its own push support. Converting a link alone does not guarantee background notifications.

System & storage

Live alert checks: every 1 second while this dashboard is open. Other data refreshes every 60 seconds, without reloading playback. Browser background timers may slow down; Web Push handles background delivery.

What SENTRA monitors

YOLO detection and object tracking support investigation of people, vehicles and configurable scene activity. Rules are evaluated by Python; this dashboard does not switch detection or safety rules off.

Reported backend configuration

Zone rules need configured zones; time rules need a reliable recording clock. Status reflects the last backend sync, not a claim that every optional rule is active. Alerts are investigation cues, not proof of wrongdoing.

About the team

SENTRA brings together video analysis, evidence storage and an investigation workspace. Use the recorded footage and context to review every alert.
